note: Madrasah Al Furqan, rendered by madrasah.html. Written by hand. The groups and their times were confirmed by the madrasah's management (Malim Husain) on 9 October 2026: five groups, six days a week, no classes on Friday. Still placeholders, each marked "placeholder": true (or "who_placeholder" on a group) and shown with a 'To be confirmed' label: which ages go in Groups 1 to 3, the term dates, places, fees and the resources list. When the madrasah confirms an item, correct it and delete its flag. When nothing is left to confirm, set "provisional" to false and the page drops its draft notice. scripts/check_madrasah.py lists whatever is still a placeholder.
confirmed: Groups and times confirmed by the madrasah on 9 October 2026.
curriculum: Children start with the Qaidah, learning to read Arabic and then the Qur'an, and go on to Qur'an kareem and tarbiyah, Islamic studies.

terms.footnote: The madrasah closes for both Eids. Eid dates depend on the moon, so they are announced nearer the time.
